sloka: तस्योरुवेगोन्मथिताः पादपाः पुष्पशालिनः ।निपेतुर्भूतले रुग्णाः शक्रायुधहता इव ।। 5.56.27 ।।।।
transliteration: tasyoruvegonmathitāḥ pādapāḥ puṣpaśālinaḥ ।nipeturbhūtale rugṇāḥ śakrāyudhahatā iva ।। 5.56.27 ।।।।

translations.english: Shaken by the violent force of Hanuman's thighs, the blossoming trees fell on the ground like sickmen hit by Indra's thunderbolt.
